description: This is a clean-page control ticket used to verify that the crawler, workflow, and Docker/K8s environment do not crash on a simple page. It is not used to evaluate ad-blocking effectiveness.
request: [Desktop][Crawler] - example.com: Control case for clean-page crawling
steps: Run the crawler and workflow in desktop environment
Verify that structured outputs are produced
Verify that the system handles a page with little or no ad evidence gracefully
expected: The pipeline completes gracefully and produces structured outputs or a no-rule result without a critical internal failure.
actual: The pipeline may fail or crash on simple pages if the environment is misconfigured.
